decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the same picture emerges: the query repeatedly differs by having more fluoroalkene character, lower Labute surface area, lower topological polar surface area when those values are available, and in several cases lower hydrogen-bond acceptor burden and lower QED. A few isolated features, such as the acyl chloride in Neighbor 2 or the alkenes in Neighbors 4 to 6, point toward the mutagenic side, but they do not outweigh the broader pattern. Since every neighbor-level comparison ultimately aligns more strongly with the non-mutagenic side, the overall prediction is option (A): is not mutagenic.
